prompts.prompt: Create a replacement production sprite sheet for THOR, the friendly golden retriever companion in a polished pixel-art farm arcade game. Reference image is identity only: golden honey coat, floppy ears, brown nose, soft cream chest, fluffy tail, friendly open mouth. Fix the stiff repeating gait and soft rendering. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background, absolutely no shadows, glow, ground, vignette, writing, grid or backdrop. EXACTLY 16 separate full-body sprites in a perfectly spaced 4-column by 4-row grid. Row 1: walking toward camera (down); row 2: walking right, full side profile; row 3: walking away from camera (up); row 4: walking left, full side profile. Four DISTINCT sequential walk phases per row: contact A, passing A, opposite contact B, passing B. Keep trunk, face proportions and body size consistent; animate articulated legs and subtle tail motion, no redesign per frame. Quadruped anatomy is critical: exactly TWO front legs and TWO hind legs. In each side-view cell ALL FOUR PAWS must read separately, far legs darker, with clear transparent gaps and correct shoulder/hip attachment. Do NOT omit a limb, fuse paws, add a fifth leg, or repeat the same leading leg in every step. Back view hind paws and front paws can be naturally occluded but retain proper structure. Left side is independently drawn, not a horizontally mirrored right side; preserve coat lighting from upper left in both directions. Crisp compact pixel-art clusters, dark warm-brown 1-to-2 world-pixel silhouette, restrained 10-color golden palette, no noisy fur texture, no blurry airbrush. Slightly elevated top-down RPG perspective matching the farm animals; grounded dog anatomy, NOT standing on two legs. Leave at least 40 transparent pixels between every sprite and at sheet edges. Consistent scale for all rows; no cropping of tails or ears. Output sheet only.

A professional top-down farm videogame golden retriever walk-cycle sprite sheet. Generate a NEW crisp pixel-art design, not a painted illustration. Transparent background. ONE honey-gold floppy-eared retriever character called Thor, no costume, cream chest, black nose, happy face, bushy tail. EXACTLY FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS (16 complete dogs). Very important row order: TOP ROW dog faces DOWN toward viewer; SECOND ROW every dog's nose points RIGHT → and tail is on the LEFT; THIRD ROW dog faces UP away from viewer, back of head visible; BOTTOM ROW every dog's nose points LEFT ← and tail is on the RIGHT. Do not repeat left-facing dogs on row 2. In each row four different consecutive walk phases: left front paw forward; passing; right front paw forward; opposite passing. All side poses show FOUR separately readable paws (two forelegs attached under shoulders + two hindlegs attached under hips). Far-side legs are darker and offset so no feet merge. Compact consistent dog silhouette; 1-to-2 pixel dark brown outline at sprite scale, golden limited palette and chunky pixel clusters, no gradients or noisy fur. Readable as 64-pixel-tall sprites in a retro arcade RPG. SAME dog scale and proportions in all cells, no body stretching. Full body, entire tail and ears inside each cell, generous empty transparent gutters, feet aligned across each row. No cast shadows, no labels, no text, no grid, no background. Production animation atlas only.

Edit this 4-by-4 transparent golden retriever sprite sheet. Fix ONLY layout and clipped contours: redraw every sprite complete and SMALLER, each dog must occupy at most 60% of its cell width and 70% of its cell height. Add 60 pixels of fully transparent empty padding on all four sides of each cell. The output has 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 fully separated dogs, no nose, tail or ear touching any cell edge or the overall canvas edge. The current sprites at the edges are clipped; repair their complete tails/noses while matching the same dog. Keep four sequential walk phases, four anatomically correct legs with separated paws on the side views, the golden pixel-art design, transparency and direction row order: down / RIGHT / up / LEFT. Retain a consistent body size, dark golden outlines, far legs darker than near legs. No text, no grid, no shadows, no color backdrop. Spacious production sprite atlas; prioritize generous transparent gutters over large dogs.
